sealed.statement: Cold-formation operation-ledger spread converges under readiness-gated voter-readiness: a five-node local MovieLens formation reaches ledger_spread_satisfied on every joiner within one barrier window (no 120s timeout-and-restart), reproduced deterministically first at the live blocking check (the DT must confirm which voter-ready or spread-progress consumer wedges when replica topology is healthy but node readiness denial is evidence-absent on barrier-held joiners), fixed by extending the evidence-absent carve-out class to that confirmed consumer without weakening any substantive readiness denial, quorum floor, or promotion guard; the full local five-node demo then reaches ACTIVE 5/5 before one profiled plus three consecutive natural five-node GCP runs meet the sealed 60-second bar.

constraints.statement: Rung 1 is a deterministic reproduction at the real blocking check confirming which consumer wedges; no fix is sealed before that confirmation, and discovery never runs on live demos.
The exact candidate requires category-complete independent approval binding its content fingerprint before GCP, audit, checkpoint, or landing.

Substantive readiness denials, the voter-ready quorum floor, the promotion guard, and the refuted CL-045 concurrent-op relaxation stay untouched; only the evidence-absent denial class may be carved out, mirroring the approved routing fail-open pattern.

Terminal proof is the full local five-node demo reaching ACTIVE 5/5, then one profiled plus three consecutive natural five-node GCP MovieLens runs with matching booted source fingerprint, ACTIVE and publication 5/5 within 60 seconds, no named gap above 3000ms, natural teardown.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

claim: Baseline control proves the joiner wedge is a cutover-era regression: at 5a4720f78 the identical local five-node demo passes the operation-ledger barrier promptly (joiner observes voters 3, distinct 3, spreadComplete true at ledger_spread_satisfied) and proceeds through grouped SQL and runtime-service phases, while at HEAD the joiner observes voters 3 distinct 1, the spread REPLACE's drain never durably completes (totalVoters stays 4), and every joiner burns the 120s barrier window and restarts. The archived HEAD-run census over every historical drain gate is zero (no would_exceed_target, no voter-ready floor block, no concurrent-op block), pointing at a consumer upstream of the drain-safety gates; replica voter-readiness consults node readiness (priority-publication-safety-topology.js isVoterReadyRoutableReplica to isNodeReadyForRouting to readiness dimensions), which a barrier-held joiner can never satisfy — the same circularity class this quest family's parent closed for query routing. Discovery trap logged: an intermediate lone-seed probe overwrote the active demo log directory mid-analysis; all citations now use the immutable archive.

hypothesis: Voter-ready floor evidence-absent carve-out at the confirmed binding check: the critical-partition remove-safety floor counts a topology-voter-ready replica whose node readiness denial consists exclusively of explicit evidence-absent codes (planning_snapshot_refresh_pending, owner_evidence_missing; empty lists fail closed), via a typed classifier and a floor-only countable filter; routing, planning, promotion, and every substantive denial keep the strict isVoterReadyRoutableReplica. DT red-to-green at the real evaluator (13 assertions incl. the substantive-denial guard staying refused and the barrier-coupling proof); neighboring remove-safety suites and readiness suites green (674 assertions); floor fix exonerated from an unrelated pre-existing local schema-job flake by a stash bisect run.

claim: Independent exact-candidate verification approved the voter-ready floor evidence-absent carve-out f2031cb1 across all nine categories, surviving the core quorum-safety attack: a genuinely dead node cannot present only evidence-absent codes on either the completed or deferred snapshot surface (buildReasons emits substantive codes unconditionally and the deferred union preserves them), dimension-denials without reasons fail closed on the non-empty requirement, and the residual one-rebuild-cycle window is backstopped by the projected-peers-contactable ping gate and matches the pre-existing stale-READY overcount class; blast radius is a single-line floor filter switch with every other consumer strict; 446 assertions, red-first with the exact live defer message, all static gates green.

hypothesis: Second confirmed spread-progress consumer closed: the natural GCP run pinned joiners at waiting_for_ledger_spread with voters 3 distinct 1 (spread REPLACE needs a placement target; targets required strict readiness; joiners are barrier-held). The evidence-absent classifier moves to one shared canonical module (readiness-denial-classification) consumed by both the voter-ready floor and the available-nodes placement filter; for the control-plane priority ledger family and the formation-liveness nodes partition only, an exclusively evidence-absent-denied node stays placement-eligible; substantive denials, empty reason lists, and ordinary partitions keep the strict filter. Red-first placement regression (9 assertions incl. mixed-denial and ordinary-partition guards), 651 assertions across affected suites, all static gates green.

claim: Natural five-node GCP run on the floor-fix checkpoint (booted fingerprint ff67f7d4 verified) failed at 2/5 ACTIVE in 97.8s and pinned the SECOND spread-progress consumer: joiners ended at waiting_for_ledger_spread with voters 3 distinct 1 (all ledger voters on the seed, exactly at target, so no drain applies) — the spread REPLACE needs a placement target, and the available-nodes readiness filter excluded every barrier-held joiner. The earlier profiled run on the same stack additionally showed the seed process halting silently mid-run with only 3 small event-loop gaps (max 6.4s), attributing that crash mode to the gap profiler's own overhead since the natural run's seed survived; performance is no longer the binding constraint. The fix extends the shared evidence-absent carve-out to placement-target eligibility for the priority ledger family and the formation-liveness nodes partition.

Independent verification approved the placement-target carve-out 36d96d78: the shared classifier module is verbatim-identical to the approved floor semantics with exactly two consumers; the carve-out branch is reached only after the strict check fails and only for priority-control-plane or formation-liveness partitions, with the constrained priority spread path additionally cohort-bounded; the placement residual (a transient evidence-absent dead node receiving an additive placement) is strictly weaker than the accepted floor residual since placement never removes data, promotion stays strictly guarded, and stranded operations clear through existing recovery; red-first isolates exactly the carve-out assertion; 386 assertions and all static gates green.

Natural run 2 on the placement-carve-out checkpoint (fingerprint 03814eb6 verified): the carve-out ENGAGED (spread REPLACE planned at 32s targeting a joiner, replicas created, seed replicas drained) but activation still missed the bar at 1/5 in 94.8s. The binding constraint is now seed event-loop freezes of 36.3s and 40.7s (13 gaps totaling 117s) whose timestamps exactly match the REPLACE dispatch-unacknowledged deferrals; joiners show zero gaps and are innocent. The freezes occur during bursts of synchronous rebalancer priority-recovery planning-gate evaluation across all 135 partitions and are present identically in natural run 1 (14 gaps, max 38.6s) before the placement carve-out, exonerating it. The profiled run cannot attribute these because the gap profiler itself crashes the seed mid-formation (log halts silently with no error), so attribution moves to a deterministic scaled sweep harness under node --cpu-prof.
